nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT sum(websocket.frames.sent) AS 'frames sent', sum(websocket.frames.received) AS 'frames received' where entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) and protocol.name = 'websocket' AND direction='INCOMING' FACET entity.name, local_addr, local_port limit max TIMESERIES

widgets.title: [INBOUND CONNECTIONS] WS Connection close : error vs normal

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT filter(sum(websocket.conn.close.count), WHERE ws.close_status_code_sent IN (0, 1000, 1001) AND ws.close_status_code_received IN (0, 1000, 1001)) AS 'normal', filter(sum(websocket.conn.close.count), WHERE ws.close_status_code_sent NOT IN (0, 1000, 1001) OR ws.close_status_code_received NOT IN (0, 1000, 1001)) AS 'error' WHERE entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) AND protocol.name = 'websocket' AND direction = 'INCOMING' FACET entity.name, local_addr, local_port LIMIT MAX TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT percentile(websocket.conn.duration, {{percentile_value}})/ 1000000 AS 'duration (ms)' WHERE entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) AND protocol.name = 'websocket' AND direction = 'INCOMING' FACET entity.name, local_addr, local_port LIMIT MAX TIMESERIES

widgets.title: [INBOUND CONNECTIONS] WS Frames per message distribution

nrqlQueries.query:
FROM Metric SELECT
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.single.sent)  AS '1 frame sent per message',
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.few.sent)     AS '2-4 frames sent per message',
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.many.sent)    AS '5-16 frames sent per message',
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.heavy.sent)   AS '17+ frames sent per message'
WHERE entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) AND protocol.name = 'websocket' AND direction = 'INCOMING' FACET entity.name, local_addr, local_port
LIMIT MAX TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.single.received)  AS '1 frame received message',
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.few.received)     AS '2-4 frames received per message',
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.many.received)    AS '5-16 frames received per message',
  sum(websocket.frames_per_msg.heavy.received)   AS '17+ frames received per message'
WHERE entity.name IN ({{entity_name}}) AND protocol.name = 'websocket' AND direction = 'INCOMING'  FACET entity.name, local_addr, local_port
LIMIT MAX TIMESERIES

widgets.title: [INBOUND CONNECTIONS] WS Connection close : status_code distribution

nrqlQueries.query:
FROM Metric SELECT sum(websocket.conn.close.count) AS 'Connection closes'
WHERE entity.name IN ({{entity_name}})
  AND protocol.name = 'websocket'
  AND direction = 'INCOMING'
AND NOT (ws.close_status_reason_sent = '' AND ws.close_status_reason_received = '')
FACET ws.close_status_reason_sent AS 'Server sent (code + description)',
      ws.close_status_reason_received AS 'Client sent (code + description)',
      entity.name, local_addr, local_port
LIMIT MAX
